_comment: The standing timing gate of the standards query service (server/lib/standards-query/standardsQueryTimingGate.js): one row per thing a caller can ask that costs differently, with its bound in seconds. Run on every demo deploy. Every registry route must have a row here or be named in exemptOperationList with why, and standards-query-registry.test.js holds that. knownSlow rows are stated, not excused: their bound is the measured cost, so getting worse fails. Bounds were set from demo's measurements of 2026-11-03: a 4-vCPU shared server, about 3.3 times slower than the Mac.

exemptOperationList.why: admin only: the gate holds no credential, and its answer costs one SQLite read

rowList.label: mappings, name search
rowList.knownSlow: reads every node three times: a name search keeps today's answer, ruled 2026-11-03; ordered single scan is a later phase

rowList.label: pair, element by name
rowList.knownSlow: reads every node once to resolve the name

rowList.label: standards
rowList.firstCallNote: one read per graph connection, then kept
